lessons.title: Why LDL falls
lessons.body: Statins reduce cholesterol synthesis in the liver. Teaching the 'why' supports adherence better than listing a number Materia has not published.

lessons.title: Muscle symptoms ≠ ignore
lessons.body: Unexplained muscle pain or weakness needs clinical review. Materia refuses to invent a dose hold or switch.

quiz.prompt: A patient on atorvastatin reports new diffuse muscle aches. Best educational frame?
choices: Muscle symptoms can be important — escalate to the clinician; do not invent a dose change
Stop all medicines immediately without advice
It means the statin is working harder
quiz.teachFromMiss: Myalgia counselling is core statin education — refer clinically; Materia never invents lipid regimens.
